title: Zeelicious Cakes — Cakes, Desserts & Small Chops, Lagos
description: Celebration cakes, wedding cakes, desserts and small chops in Lagos. See packages and prices, then book your date.

hero.headlineHtml: Cakes that make the whole room stop.
hero.text: Celebration cakes from ₦25,000, dessert boxes, vintage cakes and full wedding cake packages. Pick your cake, choose your date and pay a deposit online. No Google Forms or long WhatsApp threads.

items.title: Dessert boxes

feature.title: Wedding packages
feature.sub: Sweet Beginnings · Blissful Union · Forever Yours
feature.text: Every package includes the wedding cake, dessert servings, dessert table styling, setup, logistics within Lagos and a complimentary consultation. Blissful Union adds a cake tasting box, and Forever Yours adds a 4-tier cake for 200 guests plus a complimentary first-anniversary cake. Dates are limited, so book early.
feature.ctaMsg: On the live site couples check date availability, pick a package and pay a deposit with Paystack.

booking.title: Order your cake
booking.text: Tell us the date, the occasion and the design you have in mind. We'll confirm the price and send a payment link.
terms: Wedding bookings: send your date, venue, guest count and time of event.
Logistics within Lagos are included in wedding packages.
booking.termsNote: The live site would also show Zeelicious' own order lead times and deposit policy.
